postNotes: Copy mode registers middleware.Authz() and, when the project serves gRPC, interceptor.Authz() without arguments; mount the session check of iam ahead of them, the authenticated chains run in registration order.
Copied authz judges the caller the session check established, its user and tenant (see rbac.Subject); a project taking the tenant from elsewhere sets it on the request before Authz runs.
Use trusted tenant data such as session state, JWT claims, subdomain, or gateway-injected headers; do not trust arbitrary client headers as identity.
